pinpoints.change: setState() with the freshly computed result array merges key-by-key into the existing store array, so a shorter result leaves the previous tail in place; make the store equal the new array (reconcile/explicit truncation) instead of merging into it.

The loop is bounded by the previous dataResources_.length and only does setState(index, ...) per slot — it overwrites and extends but never drops slots for queries that disappeared; iterate the new result and remove surplus indices/resources.

setProxyState(getProxies()) merges the proxy list into the existing store array, so the returned, rendered proxyState keeps stale proxies after the queries array shrinks; replace the projection wholesale rather than assigning slot-by-slot.

Owns the symmetric contract — additions and removals are both recorded while building and get() still yields the whole value plus the diff; the projection update path must be brought in line with this add/remove symmetry.
